CraftNest
8

Decent Work &
Economic Growth

UN Sustainable Development Goal 8 aims to promote sustained, inclusive economic growth, full employment and decent work for all. CraftNest directly addresses this by empowering India's rural craft workers.

😔

The Problem

  • ❌ Artisans earn only 20–30% of product price
  • ❌ 3–4 middlemen take 70–80% of profit
  • ❌ No digital presence or market access
  • ❌ Rural craft workers live below poverty line
  • ❌ Youth abandoning traditional crafts
  • ❌ No financial inclusion or banking access
✅

CraftNest Solution

  • ✅ Artisans earn 85% directly — zero middlemen
  • ✅ Direct buyer-to-artisan connection
  • ✅ Digital storefront for every artisan
  • ✅ UPI/bank payments directly to artisan
  • ✅ Preserves traditional craft heritage
  • ✅ Women artisans get equal opportunity

SDG 8 Targets We Address

8.3
Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation and entrepreneurship — CraftNest creates entrepreneurship opportunities for rural artisans.
8.5
Achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all, including equal pay — CraftNest ensures fair, direct payment with no wage discrimination.
8.9
Promote beneficial and sustainable tourism that creates jobs — CraftNest promotes cultural craft tourism and heritage preservation.
8.10
Strengthen capacity of domestic financial institutions to expand access to banking — CraftNest enables UPI/bank payments for previously unbanked artisans.

Our Mission

CraftNest is not just an e-commerce platform — it is a movement to restore dignity, fair wages and economic independence to India's 7 million rural craft workers who have been exploited by middlemen for decades.
